name: iumrah-beta-update-20260909-published-flights-catalog-fix-v3
purpose: Make Business-published direct flight inventory actually visible in the iOS client catalog.
root_causes: The iOS service returned immediately when /flights/recommendations was merely non-empty, so a partial/stale projection could hide rows available from the storefront projection.
TripBuilder filtered one-way outbound rows against the TripDraft default arrival airport (JED), hiding valid TAS->MED publications before the user had selected an airport.
TripBuilder filtered return rows against the synthetic default departure date (+21 days), hiding currently published return inventory before an outbound publication was selected.
The storefront endpoint passed raw itinerary legs through without normalization, making older/malformed published rows more fragile for client decoding.
